sources.title: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park: Tickets, Routes, and Tips
sources.content:
Zhangjiajie National Forest Park is located in Hunan Province and serves as the real-world inspiration for the floating mountains in Avatar. Features more than 3,000 iconic sandstone columns and peaks.

Chinese Name: 张家界国家森林公园
Operating Hours: 7:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Ticket Pricing:
Park access only: CNY 236 (valid 4 days with multiple entries)
Park access plus 4-ride pass: CNY 477
Park access plus unlimited ride pass: CNY 530
VIP fast pass: CNY 980

Main Scenic Areas:
Yuanjiajie: Towering sandstone peaks, accessible via Bailong Elevator
Tianzi Mountain: Rolling cloud seas, accessible via cable car
Golden Whip Stream: Leisurely 7.5 km walk along peaceful waterway beneath 400-meter cliffs, 3-3.5 hours
Yellow Stone Village: Similar to Yuanjiajie but fewer crowds
Yangjiajie: Natural Great Wall, challenging hiking, minimal tourists
Old House Area: Sky Farmland, undeveloped wilderness for sunrise

Recommended Duration: Minimum one day (Yuanjiajie + Tianzi Mountain); recommended two days adding Golden Whip Stream; three days for complete exploration.

Day 1 Must-See Route: East Gate → Bailong Elevator → Yuanjiajie → Tianzi Mountain → cable car descent → East Gate
Day 2: South Gate → Yellow Stone Village → Golden Whip Stream

Crowd Avoidance: VIP Fast Pass saves hours during peak season. Enter 7-8 AM. Consider reverse route starting with Tianzi Mountain cable car.

Best Times: Autumn (Sept-Nov) clear skies; Summer (Jun-Aug) peak with crowds; Winter low-season pricing and potential snow; Spring improving conditions.

Accommodation: Wulingyuan Town near East Gate.

Transportation: From Hehua Airport 30-50 min taxi; From Railway Station 1 hour bus (CNY 12-15).

Since June 2025, every visit requires advance reservation including return visits on days 2-4.

Watch for wild monkeys along Golden Whip Stream. Comfortable footwear essential; even guided tours involve approximately 10,000 steps.

sources.title: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park (2026 Ultimate Guide)
sources.content:
Zhangjiajie National Forest Park 2026 ultimate guide. China's first national forest park, established in 1982. UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1992. Features over 3,000 sandstone pillars, most soaring beyond 200 meters. The park covers multiple distinct scenic areas designed to accommodate different visitor preferences and fitness levels.

Tickets cost CNY 227/pp (Mar-Oct), valid for 4 days with sightseeing bus and insurance included. Does not include elevator, cableways, sightseeing tram costs.

Five entrance gates available; most used are Wulingyuan Sign Gate (East), Forest Park Gate (South), and Tianzi Mountain Gate (North). For one day, enter from Wulingyuan Sign Gate.

Usual visit: 3 to 5 days in and around Zhangjiajie. 2 days recommended in the park. No paper maps available - download digital maps before visiting.

sources.title: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park (2026) - Tripadvisor
sources.content: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park visitor reviews. One of the most spectacular natural sites in China. The Avatar Hallelujah Mountain is a must-see. Allow at least 2 days. The Bailong Elevator is an experience in itself. Golden Whip Stream is peaceful and beautiful. Stay in Wulingyuan town for easy access. Book tickets in advance as entry requires reservation.

sources.title: 张家界国家森林公园_百度百科
sources.content:
张家界国家森林公园位于湖南省张家界市武陵源区，是中国国家5A级景区。总面积48.1平方千米，与索溪峪、天子山、杨家界三大自然保护区组成武陵源景区。

地处武陵山脉中段，以独特的石英砂岩地貌著称。有奇峰3000多座，如人如兽、如器如物，形象逼真，素有"奇峰三千，秀水八百"之誉。属北亚热带季风性湿润气候，年均气温约17℃。

历史沿革：1982年9月正式命名为国家森林公园，成为中国首个国家级森林公园。1992年12月被列入《世界自然遗产名录》。2004年被授予世界地质公园称号。2007年评定为国家5A级旅游景区。

主要景点包括黄石寨、金鞭溪、袁家界、杨家界、乌龙寨、鹞子寨等。金鞭溪全长5710米，沿线景观最为秀丽。袁家界天下第一桥跨度约50米，相对高度近400米。

生态资源：森林覆盖率97.7%，木本植物93科517种。陆生脊椎动物156种，属国家一二类保护的动物50余种。

门票：武陵源核心景区224元；开放时间3月-11月07:00-18:00，12月-2月08:00-17:00。最佳季节4月-10月。距市城区28千米。

2025年12月推出399元畅游年卡。同月新增阿凡达视角VR全景飞行体验项目。

sources.title: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park – Avatar Mountains: Complete Travel Guide (2026)
sources.content: Complete travel guide 2026 for Zhangjiajie National Forest Park and Avatar Mountains. Covers all essential information including how to get there, ticket prices, best times to visit, and detailed itineraries. The park has been recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage site under the name of Wulingyuan Scenic Area since 1992. Adults ticket CNY 224 (peak) or CNY 144 (off-peak) + CNY 3 insurance. Valid for 4 days with unlimited shuttle bus rides. Direct buses from Zhangjiajie Central Bus Station every 30 minutes, journey 40-45 minutes, tickets around CNY 12.
